prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic cinematic indoor close-up of an approved adult woman in warm geometric sunset light.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with shoulder-length dirty-blonde hair in a half-up messy bun, blue-green eyes, natural glowing skin, and minimal makeup. She wears an oversized black zip-up hoodie resting loosely off the shoulders over a white lace camisole, sits with knees bent, touches her face near one eye, and looks directly at camera with a calm intense editorial gaze.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 intimate portrait against a cream or white wall, sharp eyes and skin texture, strong geometric window-shadow lines across face and background, hand and hoodie framing the subject.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm direct golden-hour sunlight with sharp high-contrast shadows, natural skin glow, cinematic but realistic indoor atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-resolution portrait, 9:16, natural lens perspective, sharp eye focus, realistic skin and fabric, no artificial smoothing or HDR, subtle grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic 9:16 cinematic indoor portrait of an approved adult woman with shoulder-length dirty-blonde hair in a half-up messy bun, blue-green eyes, natural glowing skin, and minimal makeup. She sits with knees bent against a cream-white wall, wears an oversized black zip-up hoodie loosely off the shoulders over a white lace camisole, gently touches her face near one eye, and looks directly at the camera with a calm intense editorial gaze. Use warm direct golden-hour sunlight casting sharp geometric window shadows across her face and the wall, realistic skin texture, detailed fabric, sharp eye focus, natural contrast, and subtle grain without HDR or smoothing.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, text, logo
